catchAll.usabilityReason: Human-approved, non-suppressed contact has qualifying non-stale evidence.
warnings: Catch-all domain detected; SMTP acceptance cannot verify this mailbox or identity.

generated.usabilityReason: Human-approved, non-suppressed contact has qualifying non-stale evidence.
warnings: Generated email remains a pattern hypothesis.

stale.usabilityReason: Evidence is stale and requires fresh verification.
warnings: Contact evidence is stale and is not ready for outreach.

supported.usabilityReason: Human-approved, non-suppressed contact has qualifying non-stale evidence.

suppressed.usabilityReason: Contact is suppressed; suppression always wins.
warnings: Contact is suppressed; suppression overrides approval and all confidence signals.

unrelatedDomain.usabilityReason: Tier D evidence is a weak hypothesis and is not outreach-ready.
warnings: Contact domain is unrelated to the company-controlled domain.
